integrity: Claim proved by explicit Fourier expansion, polynomial unique-factorization, matrix rank and exact planar counterexample; symbolic checks supplement the proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires two unit-mass Gaussian densities and strictly Loewner-comparable positive-definite covariances. Does not address unequal weights, incomparable covariances, noise stability or full planar intensity identifiability. A fourth-order planar counterexample does not imply failure with higher-order or global data.
title: Fourth-order phaseless reconstruction of ordered anisotropic Gaussian pairs, with a sharp planar obstruction
